notes.notes:
TIMING: start the syrup the day before (24 h maceration). Preserves keep a few days in the fridge; stir in the syrup and acid phosphate once fully cool, the day you fill.
PRESERVES: frozen pitted sour cherries, thawed with their juice (or drained jarred Morellos); use a wide stainless pan, the fruit is acidic. The jam should sit in a well without running over in the oven; if loose, simmer longer before adding the phosphate.
WILD CHERRY SYRUP (Art of Drink, https://www.artofdrink.com/soda/cherry-phosphate): full recipe makes 12 fl oz from 1 oz bark, 1 fl oz glycerin, 4 fl oz water, 4 fl oz warm water (second steep), 4 fl oz cherry juice, 10 oz sugar. Per batch here is 1/12 (30 ml, all of it goes in). For 5 batches make ½ the recipe (~180 ml); the extra ~30 ml makes a couple of cherry phosphates (syrup + soda water + acid phosphate).
ACID PHOSPHATE: traditional ratio is ⅔ tsp per batch (1 tsp per 1½ oz syrup); MacSweetie's strength varies, so add drops to taste (bright, slightly mineral tartness) and record the count.
DOUGH: built on your Jam Thumbprint proportions (yolk only, no added liquid, no baking soda) so the wells hold.
